parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can query only one domain name at a time.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The time must be in UTC.
